items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: One was the Dodds, the drummer, who was a very good drummer and traveled extensively and better bands.

ctx.x: Oh yes. Well I've heard him in person. Do you remember some of the other outstanding musicians who played with Fade on, say, the Sidney back in that era? Well there were several good musicians.

One was the Dodds, the drummer, who was a very good drummer and traveled extensively and better bands. Later on I had a band, a family band. And the bass player is still playing in one of the bands in Chicago now. I don't remember his name. He couldn't read music at that time. But he was a very good bass player anyhow. One of the best colored bands in the business.
Let's see. Do you remember a fellow named David Jones? Yes, he was a Sullivan player.
